mentions.name: Objects-everywhere web framework
mentions.description: A web framework in which everything is an object at all times: HTML tags are objects, webpages are described at a higher meta-layout level, objects can be pushed seamlessly into PDF output, and the object model extends to all local and remote webpages, echoing Alan Kay's old ideas.
mentions.source_excerpt:
One is to finish a
webframework where everything is really an object at
all times. Meaning, I can work with objects when 
describing a webpage, from A to Z. HTML tags are 
objects too.
